lines.en: My stripes still glow in the dark.
I walk on the rising heat of hell.
The stars trail after me one by one.
I skip along, swaying side to side.
The hem of my skirt brushes hot stone.
I hum a tune nobody has ever heard.
My footprints are left behind me.
I swing wide around the open flame.
I scatter sparks with every step.
I have said hello to the moon before.

lines.zh: 这条灰路我闭着眼都能跳。
lines.en: I could skip this ash road blindfolded.
My hat has slipped a little crooked.
I count the stars stitched on my skirt.
The flames jump along with my fingers.
I am roasting a piece of candy.
The lava over there is bubbling.
I spin my hat around once.
Someone is striking stone far away.
My spell card is still warm.
Staring at fire too long makes me sleepy.
I am planning my next prank.
The moon is especially red tonight.
I draw a star with my toe.
The wind in hell is scorching.
My laughter comes back as an echo.
My striped shadow looks good, does it not?

lines.zh: 我把三色团子举到火前烤。
lines.en: I hold a dango up to the fire.
Is someone setting off fireworks below?
You do not live down here, do you?
The fire has reddened your face.
Do these stripes suit me?
Are you afraid of fire? Do not be.
I see stars reflected in your eyes.
Would you like to see my spell card?
You are standing too close; it is hot.
Did you come from the moon side?

lines.zh: 你鞋底擦灰的声音我听过。
lines.en: I know the sound your soles make on ash.
Why are you not laughing?
You have caught my interest now.

lines.zh: 你身上有草地和雨的气味。
lines.en: You smell of grass and rain from outside.
I want to show you something.
Look up; there are stars above you.

lines.zh: 你的手竟敢落在我肩上。
lines.en: Your hand actually touched my shoulder.
Did I burn you? Sorry about that.
My hat has flown off my head.
That was not fun at all.
I cannot laugh at this one.
The sparks slipped out of my hands.
I have kept the shape of your grin.
It hurts, and I will not scream.
I step back once and think.
You have earned exactly one second.
What is that, all shiny like that?
Is it candy or is it stone?
I smell burnt sugar somewhere.
Will the thing in your hand burn?
Hold it higher; I want to see.
Give it here and I will trade a spell card.
I have never seen anything like it.
Do not put it away yet.
I have followed you two steps already.
This is more interesting than lava.
Hey, you nearly knocked off my hat!
You stepped on the hem of my skirt.
My stripes are all creased now.
Move along; you are blocking the fire.
I nearly fell into the ash.
We knocked a trail of sparks loose.
Stand steady; do not lean on me.
You are heavier than stone.
I jumped clear, but only just.
One of my stars fell off.
Hell fairies do not talk about that.
I only hold conversations with the moon.
That is a strange thing to ask me.
My stars are company enough.
Who would marry someone who starts fires?
I will just laugh and walk away.
Fire is far more interesting than this.
I can amuse myself perfectly well.
Do not expect me to be shy.
I prefer a good prank.
Whose star fell down here?
I pick up a stone glowing red.
Anything that falls belongs to me.
I slip the candy into my pocket.
This stone is still hot to hold.
I pick it up, look, and toss it.
I found a spell card on the ground.
Into my pocket means it is mine.
I laugh the whole time I gather things.
Do not try to take it from me.
Someone trampled the stars I drew.
He picked up my spell card and ran.
I have decided to focus on you.
You stamped out the fire I made.

lines.zh: 这笑声是从你那儿来的。
lines.en: That laughter came from your direction.
You touched my hat a moment ago.
Let us see whether fire frightens you.
This field of ash belongs to me.
He was mocking me behind my back.
Every star has turned toward you.
I start as soon as I reach three.
I drift quietly around behind you.
Stand properly and hold still.
The spell card is in my hand.
The stars are coming down.
Are you going to run? Go on.
The sweeter I smile, the worse it is.
This stripe is aimed straight at you.
Fire gathers at my fingertips.
Keep your eyes open; this is fast.
Your shadow caught fire first.
I do like moments like this.
Retreating will not help you.
One, two, and go.
One card is enough for you.
Star and stripe crash down from above.
I shove your shoulder, and it burns.
A tongue of flame sweeps your feet.
That one was my little prank.
I hit your knee and keep smiling.
Sparks are clinging to your clothes.
Star-fire finds your collar and you hop.
My stripes flashed bright for a moment.
I clap my hands and the fire scatters.
You have not even understood it yet.
I walk out of the flames.
Ash settles on my shoulders.
Hell feels a little cold today.
Who lit those lamps over there?
I have brought the stars along.
I have already stepped across this ground.
Sparks scatter where I touch down.
The moon sent me down to take a look.
Is there something fun I can join?
My laughter arrives before I do.
The whole air smells of sulfur.
My striped shadow stretches out long.
I straighten my hat properly.
Let us begin; I am waiting.
Fire? I have always been fire myself.
I slipped all the way down the ash slope.
The water put out every bit of my fire.
The blast left my hat completely crooked.
That arrow came with a whistling sound.
Magic from someone else, how novel.
My fire is dying; I need more fuel.
The lightning above is brighter than me.
I cannot even light a fire down here.
